purpose: Teach: 潜ん/見送っ/史観/極秘/潜入/バイアス/毒性/頻発

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、ウイルス、本気で、絶対、体内に、絶対、潜んでいる場合、絶対、検査、徹底、必要ですね
lines.en: Ren, when a virus is genuinely hiding in the body, thorough testing is absolutely essential.
lines.style: Clear, measured opening. Clinical but not cold. Steady eye contact. The voice of someone who has delivered this advice a hundred times and means it each time.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 患者さんを、本気で、絶対、見送った時、医師として、絶対、本当に、辛い時間ですよね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: When you have to see a patient off like that, as a doctor… it's such a difficult moment. I'm truly grateful for you, sensei.
lines.style: Soft, genuine. A pause after the first phrase—searching for the right weight. Humble but not performative. The sincerity of someone learning what it means to witness suffering.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。医療の史観、本気で、絶対、変わってきていますね、本気で、絶対、患者中心、絶対、になってきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The philosophy of medicine itself has been changing. It's become truly patient-centered. I'm grateful you see that.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost speaking to herself first. Warm recognition in the second half. Not lecturing—affirming. The quiet satisfaction of someone in her field noticing a young person understands.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 極秘の新薬開発、本気で、絶対、医療界、本当に、絶対、楽しみですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The secret drug development happening right now—the medical world must be so hopeful about it. I'm genuinely grateful for your work, sensei.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, not flattery. Slight lift in the middle. Respectful but not deferential. The tone of someone asking because he actually wants to understand.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。新薬の臨床試験、本気で、絶対、患者さんの体内に、絶対、潜入する、技術、進歩しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're advancing the technology to study new drugs safely in patients' systems. The testing is rigorous. I appreciate your understanding.
lines.style: Professional but warm. Precise on the clinical details. No rush. The steady confidence of someone who knows her work and trusts the person she's talking to.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療の判断、本気で、絶対、バイアス、絶対、避ける姿勢、本当に、立派ですよね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The way you approach medical judgment—avoiding bias like that—it's really admirable. Thank you for that, sensei.
lines.style: Sincere admiration, not overdone. A breath before 'avoiding bias'—he's noticed something real. Quiet respect. The voice of someone who sees integrity and names it.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。新薬の毒性、本気で、絶対、徹底、絶対、検査しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The toxicity testing for new drugs is something we take very thoroughly. Thank you for your trust.
lines.style: Patient, almost gentle. A slight emphasis on 'thoroughly'—not defensive, just making sure the weight lands. Tired but steady. The voice of someone who knows this matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 新型感染症、本気で、絶対、頻発する時代、本気で、絶対、医療、頑張っていらっしゃいますよね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: In this age of so many new infections, medicine is really being tested. I'm truly grateful for everything you do, sensei.
lines.style: Quiet admiration. A slight heaviness on 'tested'—acknowledging the weight of the work. Trailing off with genuine warmth. The closing recognition of someone seeing a mentor's burden and honoring it.
